programme.title: The Maury Show
programme.desc: On this special edition of The Maury Show, Maury brings celebrity guests to the stage to share some of the most intense and shocking real-life footage ever caught on tape.

programme.title: The Maury Show
programme.desc: These women, once and for all, want to prove to their men they ARE the father of their baby and they need to be responsible for their child. Plus, did man really father a child with his neighbor behind his partner's back?

programme.title: The Maury Show
programme.desc: Alexis and Rachean met while working at a fast-food restaurant. Is Alexis now pregnant with Rachaen's child? Then, Fred cheated on Amanda with her ex-lesbian lover Ashlynn! Now both women are saying that Fred is the father!

programme.title: The Maury Show
programme.desc: After months of begging and pleading, Latoya forgave Justice for cheating. But now they’re back to test him for the same thing! Then, James could be too good to be true – is he cheating on Santa? What will the lie detector tests say?

programme.title: The Maury Show
programme.desc: Elizabeth swears that a psychic told her and her whole family that her son Nehemiah didn't father Ja'Quasia's baby. But Ja'Quasia doesn't believe in a crystal ball. Then, Heidi and Tabbi claim AJ fathered their kids, but AJ only believes Tabbi!

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show
programme.desc: Comedian Nikki Glaser and her mom Julie Glaser stop by to chat. Then, in Retro Cooking, Drew brings the 1950s tuna noodle casserole back to life. Seven-year-old Leo Kelly, aka The Shirley Temple King, stops by to whip up some Shirley Temples with Drew.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show
programme.desc: “Rebel's” Katey Sagal chats. “RHONJ's” Melissa Gorga surprises three moms with a kid-free day out they’ll never forget. Jenny Mollen creates a space for moms to clear the air in a new segment. “Home Economics's” Jimmy Tatro joins Drew’s News.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show
programme.desc: “Firefly Lane” star Katherine Heigl chats. Chef Lara Lee teaches how to make Indonesian Fried Rice. Hair stylist Jen Atkin surprises some Drew-Gooder hairstylists. Plus, “B Positive” star Terrence Terrell joins Drew and Ross at the Drew’s News desk.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show
programme.desc: “Bob Hearts Abishola” stars Billy Gardell and Folake Olowofoyeku stop by. Dr. Thanuja Hamilton who shares the biggest causes of not being able to fall asleep and tips to overcome those restless nights. Actress Kat Graham joins Drew’s News.

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show
programme.desc: Actress Annaleigh Ashford chats. Drew has a big surprise for nurse Gina Goodwin, who cooks and delivers hundreds of meals every Thanksgiving. Olympic snowboarder Jamie Anderson shares her winter skin routine. Drew reads letters in "Dear Drew."

programme.title: The Drew Barrymore Show
programme.desc: David Oyelowo joins Drew to discuss his feature directorial debut and is joined by co-star Lonnie Chavis. Plus, “Sweet Magnolias” actress Joanna Garcia Swisher chats about her online lifestyle page The Happy Place and whips up Pickled Jalapeno Corn.
